title: Durable Project-State Coverage / Portfolio Resumability Gate

source_provenance.notes: H09 selected durable project-state coverage as a portfolio gate
Prior index exposed D06-D08 recovery gaps and did not represent D01 explicitly

source_provenance.locator: D06/D07/D08 current project authority + completion updates
source_provenance.notes: Exact authorities recovered for D06-D08 instead of inferring from aggregate labels

problem_or_opportunity: Portfolio-level routers can say a project is complete/locked while a new conversation still lacks an exact durable state pointer, causing repeated work, stale pilot routing or guessed next actions.
proposed_mechanism: Maintain required_project_ids; require each required project to resolve either to a durable PASS-like state pointer or an explicit BLOCKED_RECOVERY record with reason; derive PASS_FULL vs PASS_WITH_BLOCKED_RECOVERY mechanically; validate cold-start routing without treating coverage as story quality or Founder lock.
expected_benefit: Prevents silent portfolio gaps, stale project resurrection and invented continuation while allowing independent projects to proceed when one project remains authority-blocked.
pilot_evidence: D03/D05/Book1 prior durable recovery prevented chat-memory dependency
H13-H15 recovered D06/D07/D08 exact Drive authority and superseded stale pilot-only routing
H09 coverage fixture design fails on missing required project, false full claim and routed+blocked contradiction
red_team_findings: Coverage is routing completeness only and must never become a story-completion score
A blocked project must not stop dependency-independent safe work elsewhere
State pointers themselves can become stale and require a future staleness detector/freshness sweep
D01 remains explicit BLOCKED_RECOVERY until exact authority is persisted
next_action: Run repository CI, cold-start D06-D08 from only their durable state files, keep D01 explicitly blocked, then decide PILOT_PASS or repair.
notes: Candidate gate; no authority promotion from internal fixtures alone.
